title: Stehgeiger
failed: Easy Effects did not answer; trying again in a minute
no-profiles: No output profiles: make a preset in Easy Effects first

missing.title: Easy Effects is not installed
missing.subtitle: Stehgeiger switches Easy Effects presets; install easyeffects first

stopped.title: Easy Effects is not running
stopped.subtitle: Start Easy Effects (easyeffects --service-mode); Stehgeiger never starts it itself

unanswered.title: Easy Effects does not answer
unanswered.subtitle: Stehgeiger asks again in a minute

empty.title: No presets yet
empty.subtitle: Make one in Easy Effects, or check the profiles in Settings → Plugins → Stehgeiger

output_profiles.label: Output profiles
output_profiles.description: Label=preset pairs, separated by commas, in the order the tile cycles through them, e.g. "Headphones=headphones-eq, Speakers=speakers-flat". Empty: every output preset, by name

input_profiles.label: Input profiles
input_profiles.description: Label=preset pairs for the launcher, like the output profiles. Empty: every input preset, by name
